titulo: The $80 GTA 6 box has no disc inside
descripcion:
The fine print: what you agree to when you buy this.

The press release of Take-Two Interactive, the game's publisher (Jun 24, 2026), says the physical version of Grand Theft Auto VI contains "a download code inside the box". The standard edition is $79.99. TechTimes, a tech news site (Nov 9, 2026), reports that the code-in-box "eliminates resale value for physical buyers". GamesRadar, a games news site, quotes Rockstar: the pre-load file "will require up to 212 GB depending on your device".

This is a plain reading of a press release and press reports: not legal advice. Check the terms at your own store before you buy. The voice is synthetic.
